dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High grayscale contrast; visibility is clear; bands are composed of thin white feather tips on the median and greater coverts creating a tiered horizontal effect.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High visual prominence with sharp, thin white boundaries along the length of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers against dark centers.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive, high-contrast scalloped pattern across all visible dorsal plumage regions.
